name: Numbuh 98.6
source:
Name: Sandra Deets

Designation: Numbuh 98.6

Sector: G

Position: Medical Officer


Numbuh 98.6's curiosity and overwhelming need to get results is both a blessing and a curse. Her drive has lead to dozens of innovations over the years, but just as many..."incidents".

Her mood can be as tempestuous as her experiments, ranging from happy go luck, to flirty, to downright scary!


"Downright scary? Me? Now that's a little dramatic~."
